author: Sevoo
body:
I logged on to Avicus at around 11:30 today and it said I was banned for Void Logging. I had void logged the other 2 times I got an infraction, but I wasn't even online today. You will realize, that it says I was, but take my word for it, that I wasn't. I have absolutely no idea how it says I was online at that time, because I came home from school, went to my cousin's house, played for around 5 minutes and then watched TV. I went back to my house and watched TV, and then I decided I would play MC. I warmed up on Kohi and then logged onto Avicus, and saw that I was banned for "Void Logging. Third offense". Either this is false or someone has hacked me. Anyways, at the time when I was banned, I was playing FIFA 15 on the PS3 at my cousin's house. I have already sent an email to Avi support, if that's still to the way to do this kind of thing. I wasn't really around when the Omega Update happened, so I might have missed a couple of things. Please help, I have no idea wtf is happening. Sorry for the inconvenience...

-In best regards, Sevo
